phrase: an Online Art and Craft Supplies Store
verdict: Yes. Hobby India from Surat pitched an online art and craft store on Shark Tank India Season 2, but didn't get a deal. Hobbies like painting, resin art and crafts have grown, and buyers want everything in one place.
angle: Craft hobbyists buy supplies often. A wide range, fast delivery and tutorials keep them coming back. Workshops and kits add revenue.
